name: rainforest-navigator
description: Query and manage RainForest Navigator Chrome-extension data through its OAuth-enabled cloud relay, with a website icon generation skill.

interface.shortDescription: Manage extension navigation through remote MCP.
interface.longDescription: Search, add, edit, delete, and apply generated SVG icons to entries stored in the RainForest Navigator Chrome extension, without running a local MCP process.
defaultPrompt: Search my local RainForest navigation entries.
Add a site and generate a matching RainForest icon.
Update an entry in my Chrome extension.
